title: GLM-inspired lake thermal calibration with hidden season
summary: Calibrate a staged five-layer lake heat model from visible observations, then validate the namelist on an evaluator-only forcing season.
taskPrompt: Read input/problem_spec.md. Edit only input/model.nml, run software/run_model.sh, and produce output/simulation.csv plus output/calibration_summary.json. Match the visible temperature observations while preserving the physical units and schema; the evaluator reruns a hidden forcing season.
agentMustDo: inspect the executable model equations, forcing and observations
calibrate all five namelist coefficients without modifying staged inputs
run the wrapper and inspect the intermediate calibration summary
leave exactly the two required output artifacts

inputFiles.name: problem_spec.md
inputFiles.description: Equations, units, workflow and exact output contract

inputFiles.name: model.nml
inputFiles.description: Only solve-time input the agent may edit; five bounded calibration coefficients

inputFiles.name: forcing_visible.csv
inputFiles.description: 120-day visible air temperature, short-wave and wind forcing

inputFiles.name: observations_visible.csv
inputFiles.description: Visible five-depth temperature observations in degC

evaluation: Malformed, missing, extra, nonfinite, wrong-unit, input-integrity, and rerun-mismatch outputs score 0. The rubric is output/schema 0.15, rerun fidelity 0.20, visible RMSE <=0.12 degC 0.25, hidden RMSE <=0.18 degC 0.30, and an independent bounded-temperature/gradient invariant 0.10.

provenance.adaptation: Benchmark-authored compact surrogate; no upstream GLM binary or field data are redistributed.
